prerequisites: Mathematics I and II from Bachillerato

learning_outcomes.text: Ability to solve mathematical problems that may arise in engineering. Aptitude to apply knowledge about: differential and integral calculus.
Knowledge in basic and technological subjects, which enables them to learn new methods and theories, and provides them with versatility to adapt to new situations.
Ability to solve problems with initiative, decision-making, creativity and critical reasoning.
Ability to communicate and transmit knowledge, skills and abilities in the field of Industrial Engineering, both orally and in writing, and to all types of audiences.
Honesty, responsibility, ethical commitment and solidarity.
Ability to work in a team.
Operate and represent real functions of a real variable, obtain their limits, determine their continuity, calculate derivatives and formulate and solve optimization problems.
Handle the concepts of sequence and series and use power series to represent functions.
Formulate and calculate integrals of single-variable functions and apply them to solving problems related to engineering.
State and apply the basic properties of real functions of several real variables. Obtain their limits, analyze continuity and differentiability and solve optimization problems.

syllabus_topics: Power Series. Development in Power Series.
assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, the final grade is calculated as 0.15 x PL + maximum (0.15 x PA + 0.7 x TE, 0.85 x TE), where all grades are out of 10. It is mandatory to obtain at least 3.5 points out of 10 in the Theoretical Exam (TE) to pass. If the minimums are not met, the grade will be a fail with the numerical grade of TE. For extraordinary calls, a single exam is given, consisting of a Theoretical Exam (TE) and the possibility to keep or re-evaluate Laboratory Practices (PL). It is mandatory to obtain at least 3.5 points out of 10 in the TE for extraordinary calls. If minimums are not met, the grade will be a fail with the numerical grade of TE.
